principle.name: TOOL REACH OUTRUNS ROOT; RECOVERY REPAYS THE TOOL FIRST
principle.repair_interpretation: The repair makes that principle embodied: rear load and pelvis drop earn the spear launch; contact is pinned while the body compresses; shoulders overtravel after release; the spear retracts before the root is permitted home; the final stance retains cost.

BRIDGE_DROP makes body commitment precede weapon launch
CONTACT and HITSTOP_CATCH separate reach from force absorption

rounds.correction: Lowered DRIVE/CONTACT root and chest, deepened front brace and impact compression, aligned the overtravel shaft with both hands, and increased residual recovery debt.

rounds.correction: Raised and advanced the chest/shoulders while keeping the tip pinned, compressed the pelvis without folding the torso, and smoothed the recovery-debt geometry.
rounds.highest_value_visible_defect: HITSTOP_CATCH collapsed the torso around the shaft and briefly read as a broken rig instead of transferred impact.

rounds.correction: Made COIL_LOCK unmistakable: spear pulls farther behind the body, rear load widens, shoulders/hands stagger, and the forward corridor becomes visibly empty before BRIDGE_DROP.
